title: Rider fails to debug GDScript with Godot 4.6-rc2
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6-rc1 and 4.6-rc2, but not in 4.5.1.

Rider 2025.3.1, same version of GDScript and Godot plugins.

### System information

Godot v4.6.rc2 - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 11 Jan 2026 17:10:53 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (radeonsi, navi31, LLVM 21.1.6, DRM 3.64, 6.18.5-arch1-1) - AMD Ryzen 9 9900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 60.44 GiB memory

### Issue description

In 4.6-rc1 and 4.6-rc2, Rider's debugger fails to attach to debug GDScript. The engine very briefly seems to enter play mode, and instantly stops.

Godot's logs appear empty, and nothing appears in the engine's output. This is the output of three subsequent attempts to debug from Rider's logs, though:
```

2026-01-20 18:58:54,055 [ 203202]   INFO - #c.i.w.i.i.j.s.JpsGlobalModelSynchronizerImpl - Saving global entities com.intellij.platform.workspace.jps.entities.LibraryEntity to files

```

### Steps to reproduce

* Download the repro project.
* Ensure Rider is set as the external text editor.
* Open the script on  the `Sprite2D` node in the main `repro.tscn` scene in Rider.
* Hit debug under the "Player GDScript" configuration.
* The behaviour as noted should occur.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[rider-debug-repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24748627/rider-debug-repro.zip)
